decks.summary: Introductory Hemlock Vale Kate who moves clues onto Fingerprint Kits, Magnifying Glasses and Empirical Hypothesis for bonuses, drawing hard with Dream-Enhancing Serum and Laboratory Assistants.
The level 0 start of Kate Doesn't Need Roads: Fingerprint Kit, Magnifying Glass and Empirical Hypothesis powered by Flux Stabilizer clues, with Tinker for slots and Preposterous Sketches for draw.
Science-kit Kate with Chemistry Sets, Microscopes, Alchemical Distillation and Magnifying Glasses on Tinker, drawing fast with Dream-Enhancing Serum and paid for by Milan.
Clue-shuffling Kate who drops clues with Captivating Discovery for Research Notes, freeing her Science and Tool assets for Flux Stabilizer's bonus again; built for a four-player Hard run.
Two-box Hemlock Vale Kate who gains hand slots from Dr. Charles West III to run two Microscopes, Magnifying Glass and Flashlight, with Ravenous Myconid and Chemistry Set as extra Science.
Feed the Mind Kate at 9 XP who uses card advantage to solve problems: Practice Makes Perfect, Cryptic Writings and Burning the Midnight Oil, with Higher Education for tests.
Story-mode Kate who sits at one location and blanks treacheries with Prophesiae Profana while killing enemies through Ancient Stone draws, leaving most clues to her friends.
Thematic science Kate with up to 14 Science and Tool assets: Fine Tuning on Chemistry Set or Antikythera, and Inquisitive and Steady-Handed to hit the exact results they pay for.
A "One for All" template Kate built from a single shared card collection, with generic Seeker tools and filler upgrades; more a collection exercise than a tuned deck.
Standalone cartographer Kate who draws a big hand with Cryptic Research, Practice Makes Perfect and Laboratory Assistants, oversucceeds with Magnifying Glass, and fires events through Farsight.
